Rob O'Neill explains that difficult long-term goals become manageable when they are reduced to the next small action. During demanding training, focus on reaching the next workout, meal, or rest period instead of mentally carrying the entire challenge at once.

* Create momentum through small wins early in the day.
* Focus on the next action instead of the full burden.
* Treat tomorrow as a clean start after a difficult day.
* Never make the decision to quit in the emotional moment.
